mathematics.assertion_tested: For each of the six pre-existing 12-basis canonical kinetic witnesses, direct finite canonical deformations reproduce the independently integrated quadratic curvature and decrease full energy in both signs when the first-variation residual is controlled.
mathematics.coefficient_domain: float64 static and scalar BVPs, Gauss-Legendre quadrature, stable finite energy increments
mathematics.conventions: Q is the second energy derivative, not the t-squared coefficient. r_t=r+t xi(r), p=J^-T p0, s_t(x)=s0(x)+t sigma(x). The scalar domain remains fixed; an asymptotic quadratic exterior tail closes its finite boundary.
inputs: All six refined 12-component vectors from kinetic_run_002/result.json; same frozen PN28 background source

bounds.cases: psi_c in [0.8,0.95,0.99] crossed with epsilon in [0.0001,0.01]
bounds.witness_selection: last quadrature evaluation, last nested basis, no optimization
bounds.step_normalization: M=max(1,abs(xi_prime),abs(xi/r),abs(sigma),abs(xi)/min(R,L-R)) sampled on 4097 interior and 4097 scalar points; h=normalized_step/M
bounds.finite_difference_tolerance: relative to abs(Q), at most 0.001 on the two smallest steps of each quadrature; abs(Q)>1e-7 required
bounds.quadrature_tolerance: difference of independently integrated Q at 512 and 1024 divided by max(1,abs(Q1024)) below 3e-5
bounds.original_curvature_tolerance: difference from frozen original witness divided by max(1,abs(Q)) below 3e-5
bounds.negative_energy: both plus and minus direct energy increments must be negative for the two smallest steps, at both quadratures
bounds.admissibility: all stretches positive and deformed matter radius lies inside L

non_claims: No new fit or optimized witness

declared result files are present and regular

residual_risks: Command success does not establish the mathematical interpretation.
